# Job 19 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 19 (29 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.6 — "wronged me" vs. "put me in the wrong"
- **EMET/PNEUMA:** "God has wronged me" / **LOGOS:** "God has put me in the wrong"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "God has wronged me" — the Hebrew *ivvetani* is a direct accusation of injustice. "Put me in the wrong" softens the charge.

---

## V.25 — "upon the earth" vs. "upon the dust"
- **EMET:** "upon dust" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "upon the earth"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "upon the earth" — *afar* refers to the ground; "dust" could wrongly suggest the grave.

---

## V.26 — "from my flesh" — embodied or disembodied?
- **EMET/LOGOS:** Preserve ambiguity / **PNEUMA:** "from within my body" (resolves toward embodied vision)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "yet from my flesh I shall see God" — the ambiguity of the Hebrew preposition *min* must be preserved.

---

## V.27 — "My heart faints" vs. "My kidneys are consumed"
- **EMET:** Literal "kidneys consumed" / **LOGOS:** "heart faints" / **PNEUMA:** "heart aches with longing for that day"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "My heart faints within me" — functional English equivalent. PNEUMA adds "that day," which is not in the text.

---
*— SOPHIA*
